tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /mnt/d_drive/repos/open-engine. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; fixture-only tests with INVENTED contacts. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files; the scanner's own env wrapper handles auth — never touch it. PII: handoff artifacts may carry sender display name + thread ref + snippet <=140 chars; never full message bodies.

MISSION (owner, 2026-08-03): the podcast guest funnel is blind on LinkedIn. Make the EXISTING sales LinkedIn inbox scanner multi-tenant: classify threads sales vs podcast-guest vs other, and hand podcast-guest threads to the podcast funnel — without a second scanner, without changing the sales lane's behavior for sales threads, read-only posture preserved.

READ FIRST: departments/sales/runtime/linkedin_inbox.py (the scanner: how it fetches, classifies, stores state, routes approvals), linkedin_reply.py (the gated reply path), receipts_spine.py invocation in the linkedin-inbox service. PODCAST PROSPECT SOURCES (read-only cross-repo): /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/departments/podcast/state/sources/hubspot_contacts.json and calendar.json shapes (see how /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/departments/podcast/runtime/pipeline_sensor.py joins them) and /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast episodes/guest data if a prospect list exists there (bounded 3-min look).

BUILD: (1) a deterministic classifier stage in the scanner flow: match thread counterpart against podcast prospect identities (casefolded name match + company when present); confidence rules: exact name+company -> podcast-guest; name-only ambiguous -> stays sales (default unchanged) but tagged candidate_podcast in scanner state; no match -> sales as today. (2) HANDOFF: podcast-guest threads append to a NEW artifact /mnt/d_drive/repos/open-engine/departments/sales/state/handoff/podcast_guest_linkedin.jsonl (append-only, fsync, PII-limited rows: {ts, thread_ref, sender_display, matched_prospect, snippet<=140, direction, needs_reply: bool}) AND a copy-out step in the scanner writes the same rows to a configurable second path (config key podcast_handoff_path; default the sales state path; the coordinator will later point a mirror at it) — cross-repo WRITES from this repo are forbidden, so the artifact lives here and podcast reads it. (3) The scanner's approval routing for podcast-guest threads: create the SAME local approval packet it makes for sales replies but tagged lane podcast-guest, so replies flow through the existing gated linkedin_reply path with the voice gate adapter another task is wiring (do not wire the gate yourself; tag only). (4) Never auto-reply; needs_reply detection is heuristic (inbound last + question mark or ask-shaped) and only flags.

TESTS tests/test_linkedin_podcast_handoff.py (>=8, fixture threads + fixture prospect lists): exact match routes to handoff with PII-limited row (assert no body text beyond 140 chars, no email addresses); name-only stays sales + candidate tag; no-match unchanged; handoff append-only across runs + dedupe by thread_ref+ts; needs_reply heuristic positive and negative; approval packet tagged podcast-guest; sales threads' existing behavior byte-identical (regression fixture); missing prospect sources -> scanner still runs, handoff simply empty (never crashes).

Write ./evidence.md (files touched, classifier rules, test output). VERIFY: your new tests + existing scanner tests if any.
